hero.title: Claim your rank.
hero.description: Daily Question of the Day, 1-on-1 Duels, Private Rankings for your class or friends — earn Coins for every vote and climb from Bronze to Legend.

vote.title: Vote
vote.description: Daily Question, a 1-on-1 Duel, or a Private Ranking — one click a day is enough.

coins.title: Collect Coins
coins.description: Every vote, streak, and Daily Box you open earns you Coins automatically.

ranks.title: Climb the Ranks
ranks.description: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Legend — your standing grows every day.

coins.title: Coins & Rank
coins.description: Earn Coins for daily activity and climb from Bronze to Legend.

duel.title: Duel of the Day
duel.description: A random 1-on-1 matchup from across the whole app every day — you pick the winner.

question.title: Question of the Day
question.description: One poll for the whole community — see how you compare to everyone else.

streaks.title: Streaks & Missions
streaks.description: Daily tasks with rewards — don't worry, a Streak Freeze has your back.

friends.title: Friends & Chat
friends.description: Add friends by nickname and message each other — available in the mobile app.

zeroHate.title: Zero Hate
zeroHate.description: Only system-picked, positive questions — no room for meanness.

pojedynekDnia.title: Duel of the Day
pojedynekDnia.notEnoughUsers: Not enough people in the Overall Ranking yet to create today's duel.
pojedynekDnia.voted: Voted — come back tomorrow for the next duel.

topki.title: Rankings
topki.intro: Vote daily in your class or with friends — whoever gets the most votes wears the crown until tomorrow.
topki.appRankingDesc: An automatic ranking that adds up votes across all your Rankings — you don't vote here, it just shows who has the most.
topki.namePlaceholder: e.g. Class 3A or the neighborhood crew
topki.maxTwo: You can create up to 2 Rankings.
topki.maxFive: You already belong to the maximum of 5 Rankings.
topki.noVotesYet: No one has voted today yet

reportTile.title: Report a bug
reportTile.desc: Something not working? Let me know

friends.inviteOutside: Invite from outside the app (+50 Coins)
friends.howItWorksText: You add someone by nickname → they need to accept it on their end → then you both see each other on the list and can message each other (only emojis and preset phrases — no free text, on purpose, for safety).
friends.empty: No one here yet — add your first friend above.
friends.sentInvites: Sent invites — waiting for a response
friends.errExists: You're already friends, or an invite is already pending.

chat.empty: No messages yet — write something or send an emoji.
chat.forbiddenWord: This message contains a forbidden word.

appearance.darkModeDesc: Dark background instead of light — easier on the eyes in the evening.

streak.fact1: One vote a day (anywhere) = streak grows by 1
streak.fact2: Freezes: {{count}} — save your streak when you forget to vote
streak.fact3: 7 days = +50 Coins, every next 30 days = +200 Coins

reportBug.intro: Something not working or looking weird? Tell me exactly what you see — the more detail, the faster I can fix it.
reportBug.placeholder: E.g. nothing happens after clicking 'Vote', the screen stays blank...

security.googleHint: You log in via Google — you can also set a password to be able to log in with email and password too.
security.tooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.

account.title: Account
account.notificationsDesc: New message, friend invite, Question of the Day, and streak reminder.
account.mobileOnly: Push notifications only work in the Android app — install it to enable them.
account.deleteWarning: Deleting your account is permanent — your profile, votes, and any Rankings you created disappear (along with the Ranking, other members lose it too). This can't be undone.
account.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account? This action is irreversible and will delete all your data.
account.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the account. Try again or contact us.

identity.intro: What others see in your Rankings: name, nickname, and avatar.
identity.name: Name
identity.platformsLegend: Already have an account on any of these platforms?
identity.forbiddenWord: Your name, nickname, or bio contains a forbidden word — fix it and try again.
identity.nickTaken: That nickname is already taken — choose another.
